·˚✿ POLLINATIONS WEEKLY ✿˚·
    vol.44: keys, models & apps

1. From November 1, pk_ keys identify OAuth apps, not API requests. Generation needs a server-side sk_ key or a user-authorized key via Connect User Wallets. Enter, CLI, SDK, and docs reflect the split.

2. Model Monitor compares community-model Trust with the official models they are named after. Health data separates Pollen-related 402s from other 4xx errors. Community Watch adds fallback and listing-change notices.

3. My Apps lets signed-in users submit an app without an existing listing. Its card grid shows 24-hour request counts. Six apps joined the catalog. Traffic matching no longer credits sibling apps for each other's requests.

4. Refusal-only answers reach Messages, CLI, and SDK. Blank answers are handled before caching. An explicit output limit with no answer returns a guided 400 in affected paths.

5. The CLI gained model and voice search. polli sites deploy --verify checks published files against the local build. A failed check exits nonzero; the Site stays published. SDK media helpers return stored URLs.

The repo is public: https://github.com/pollinations/pollinations
